# T-4: Update test-review lifecycle

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Move test-review from one-shot STOP behavior to bounded fix/re-review and semantic deferral at retry exhaustion.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5 test-review repairs happen between separate review invocations, not inside an internal command auto-fix loop.
- R5 each semantic FAIL invocation consumes reviewRetry until the existing retry limit.
- R5 semantic test-review findings defer to acceptance-review at the limit.
- TOOLING_FAILURE remains separate and still requires recovery or structured override evidence.

## Implementation Notes
Update src/flow/commands/review.js, run-review phase parsing, plan/test-review prompt text, and any post-hook/status handling in definition.js or registry.js that assumes test-review FAIL is one-shot. Do not add a command-internal auto-fix loop.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests for test-review semantic retry exhaustion and TOOLING_FAILURE separation; update shared tests for prompt and post-hook routing where needed.
